output.summary: KEP-917 proposed managing the kubernetes/kubernetes vendor folder with go modules and defining go.mod files for published components such as k8s.io/client-go and k8s.io/api. Its status is implemented, stage stable (implementable from 2020-12-30, implemented from 2021-05-05).
output.rationale:
Godep was unmaintained, had slow vendor verification (about 30 minutes in the pull-kubernetes-godeps job) and functional problems with diamond dependencies. Go modules were the go toolchain's supported dependency mechanism, and go1.13 was planned to enable them by default. The KEP also cited a 10x rebuild speedup over Godep in preliminary tests and reproducible vendor directories across OSes.</rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">null

alternatives.option: Continue using godep for vendor management
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the tool is unmaintained ("Please use dep or another tool instead."), and the project had to maintain its own fork; it also had performance and functional problems.

alternatives.option: Use an alternate dependency tool such as dep or glide
alternatives.why_not: The readme says some of these tools (like glide) are also unmaintained, and go modules have stronger support statements from the go tool.

alternatives.option: Stop vendoring in k8s.io/kubernetes as part of the move to go modules
alternatives.why_not: The readme says vendoring is still necessary for reproducible builds in hermetic environments based on published repositories, and that moving away from vendoring is orthogonal and could be pursued later.

alternatives.option: Stop publishing staging component repositories and have consumers reference modules inside a clone of k8s.io/kubernetes
alternatives.why_not: The readme says pre-1.15 SHAs would not be available as modules, vanity import meta tags cannot point to a nested path, and cloning the very large kubernetes repo is unpleasant for consumers.

evidence.quote: Manage the vendor folder in `kubernetes/kubernetes` using go modules, and define `go.mod` module files for published components like `k8s.io/client-go` and `k8s.io/api`.
The plan of record](https://blog.golang.org/modules2019) is for go1.13 to enable go modules by default and deprecate GOPATH mode.
The tool is unmaintained (the project readme states "Please use dep or another tool instead."), and we have had to make our own fork to work around some edge cases.
To ensure reproducible builds in hermetic build environments based solely on the published repositories, vendoring is still necessary
The only documentation changes are developer facing and have already merged: * https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/master/INSTALL.md#go-modules
